verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate banking/card SaaS with a public API, so an official CLI is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers a REST API, OAuth client credentials, an interactive playground, Markdown docs and llms.txt, but nowhere documents an official command-line tool. The playground and API are adjacent developer building blocks, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
